deviations.what: A wooden pipe drops a stack that no inventory accepts as one item entity per item, instead of as one entity holding the stack.
deviations.why: item_stack in mod_api.json makes a stack of one and has no count, so the pipe spawns an entity for each item it carries.

deviations.what: On b1.7.3-stationapi the redstone engine's item is drawn with the game's per-face shading, where 2.2.14's item render and the port on every other loader draw it with GL lighting off. The plate sits at the reference's progress 0.25 everywhere.
deviations.why: StationAPI draws a baked item model with fixed-function lighting, and only turns that off for a model whose GUI light is not side lit. The port draws the engine's item through that renderer rather than the loader's own item renderer, so it cannot turn the lighting off without mixing into StationAPI's renderer.

deviations.what: The wooden pipe's collision and selection boxes are the full block, not the reference's centre-and-arms boxes.
deviations.why: mod_api.json has no entry for a block's collision or selection box, so GrugBlock keeps the vanilla full cube while the reference sets both from its centre-and-arms bounds.
